<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Let me probe each rotator to see which frame it controls
# First, let me save the current state

seg = current_frame.segmentation
nodes = seg['nodes']

# Get current tile colors by position
tile_state = {}
for n in nodes:
    if n['pixels'] == 4:
        b = n['boundary']
        r = min(row for row, col in b)
        c = min(col for row, col in b)
        if r >= 11:  # gameplay area
            tile_state[(r,c)] = n['color']

print("Current tile state (gameplay area):")
for pos in sorted(tile_state.keys()):
    print(f"  {pos}: {tile_state[pos]}")

# Now click on the top red rotator (16,19) and see what changes
print("\n=== Clicking top red rotator (16,19) ===")
action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': 16, 'col': 19}])

# Get new tile state
seg2 = current_frame.segmentation
nodes2 = seg2['nodes']
tile_state2 = {}
for n in nodes2:
    if n['pixels'] == 4:
        b = n['boundary']
        r = min(row for row, col in b)
        c = min(col for row, col in b)
        if r >= 11:
            tile_state2[(r,c)] = n['color']

# Find changed tiles
changed = []
for pos in tile_state:
    if pos in tile_state2 and tile_state[pos] != tile_state2[pos]:
        changed.append((pos, tile_state[pos], tile_state2[pos]))

print(f"Changed tiles: {changed}")
print(f"Board changed: {last_action_result.get('board_changed')}")
</parameter>
</function>
